description: Test your reaction and agility in this soccer fuelled sliding and matching game, featuring three different and addictive modes. Use explosive power-ups to help you along, and play through numerous fun packed levels as you try your hardest to master the game. Beat your friend's scores on the leader boards and share your successes with them on Facebook!? Brilliant visuals, which look absolutely stunning on the new HD iPads and iPhone 5.? Soccer theme.? Awesome power ups.? Three uniquely different modes; Arcade, Zen and Score Panic.? Each mode is easy to learn, yet hard to master.? Helpful hint feature or rotate the board if you get really stuck.? Separate leader boards for each mode and a combined board to show who's really the champion!? Climb the leader boards and share your success with your friends on Facebook.? Progress is saved in every mode - try out the different modes without losing your saves.ARCADE MODEFast paced matching fun is on offer in the Arcade mode. Test your skill and reflexes as you race to complete the level before the timer overpowers you. Keep an eye out for the 'Extra Time' power up - you're going to need it!SCORE PANICCan you reach the target score before your time runs out? The target score is increased after every level making this mode more and more challenging. Just don't panic!ZENRelax and chill in Zen mode, without a timer to harry and panic, you can lay back and focus on an addictive, never ending game of gem match. We even lower the music a couple of notches!GAME PLAYMatch 3 games are puzzle games. You need to match 3 or more objects by sliding rows or columns with your finger. Matched pieces are removed from the board and new pieces dropped back onto the board. The object is to clear the board and advance to the next level.If you're unsure of the next move then press the hint button for some help. The board will darken and an arrow will show you a row or column to slide, with a starting piece and a target piece. Slide the starting piece in the direction of the arrow, until it arrives at the slot previously occupied by the target - you now got a match! Alternatively, you can rotate a quadrant of the board by pressing one of the rotate buttons that are situated in each corner of the board.Matching 4 or more pieces can trigger the spawning of power ups with special abilities, helping you clear larger areas of the board:SPECIAL PIECES? Cool As A NinjaThis laid-back chick wants to help YOU! Double tapping her will unleash her cold fury, causing her to destroy all pieces that match her colour.? Rainbow RoosterThis colourful rooster is a special bird that can be matched with ANY other coloured piece.? Cluck This!This bad boy gives out an immense boiling heat which is capable of totally destroying all pieces in the same vertical or horizontal line.? Angry Bird!This bird is absolutely fuming and will destroy all pieces in the area surrounding it. Double tap to activate it and blow the balls to smithereens!? Extra Time!Double tap to pause the timer for a short while. Hurry though, it doesn't last forever!? Left Back RoosterTo the left, to the left… This rooster can destroy all pieces to it's left!? Right Back RoosterRight? Right! This rooster can destroy all pieces to their right.? Horizontal DisintegratorThis powerful piece packs a punch! It destroys all pieces within the same horizontal line as it, reducing them to piles of dust!? Vertical VaporiserThis Vaporiser contains bottled lightning, which ZAPS anything in the same vertical line as it.GUARANTEEThe loyalty and trust of our customers is very important to us. conclusion.summary: Блогер делится своими впечатлениями от прохождения психологического хоррора 771, состоящего из семи уникальных сегментов. Основное внимание в ролике уделяется реакциям игрока на атмосферу, звуки и визуальные образы, а также многочисленным отступлениям на темы еды и аниме. Блогер отмечает довольно короткое прохождение основной части игры, что вызвало у него некоторое удивление.

conclusion.verdict: Игра оставляет смешанные впечатления: с одной стороны, она успешно создает пугающую атмосферу и использует узнаваемые визуальные образы, но с другой — блогер был разочарован краткостью прохождения полной версии игры.
